hints.title: Prefix Function Matching
hints.text: For each word, concatenate word + '#' + target and compute the prefix function prefix function pi. This discovers the longest prefix of word ending at each character of target in linear time.

hints.title: Shifted Prefix Propagation
hints.text: If a prefix match of length L starts at index i, a valid prefix match of length at least L - 1 exists starting at index i + 1. Propagate this forward in one linear scan.

hints.title: Greedy Jump Intervals
hints.text: With maximum forward reach known for every position, apply Jump Game II greedy interval expansion to find the minimum number of jumps to reach the end.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: KMP runs in linear time for each word string concatenated with target.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: O(|target|^2) trie traversals encounter TLE when |target| reaches 5 * 10^4.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Linear prefix function arrays reused per word.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Uses KMP prefix function or Aho-Corasick with Jump Game interval expansion.
